C1582.title: Cloudflare Analysis: Microchips and IoT Devices Become New Vectors for Supply Chain Attacks
C1582.summary: In a March 2022 analysis, Cloudflare noted that while software supply chain attacks remain the most common, attack methods have diversified. Adversaries can target hardware such as microchips, laptops, IoT devices, and operational technology (OT), even implanting malicious code at the firmware level.
